clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle needs NG-5 for his explosive plans. The volatile chemical is Nitromirglyceronium, the ignition compound he needs to set off wagons loaded with dynamite as a distraction.

Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome operative in the Stonetalon Mountains, needs NG-5 for his engineering plans. The compound is formally known as Nitromirglyceronium, a hazardous chemical solution that demands care—or reckless gnomish enthusiasm. Gaxim says it provides the reaction needed to detonate entire wagons loaded with dynamite, creating a massive explosion to distract his adversaries in the region.
